capabilities: Upload pasted and dragged images to S3-compatible storage
Insert Markdown links for uploaded images
Upload all image references in a note, including remote HTTP(S) images
Download remote images into the local attachment folder
Test connection and public URL access
extras: Credentials are stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json and may be copied by vault sync or backups; uploaded objects are not made public, so a read policy or CDN is needed for links to work. The fork uses a new plugin ID, so users of the original plugin must reinstall into a new directory.
intentEvidence: No PicGo, desktop helper, or upload server is required.
problem: Obsidian stores pasted images as local attachments, with no built-in way to host them on S3-compatible object storage and link to them from notes.

relations.evidence: No PicGo, desktop helper, or upload server is required.
Starting with 5.0.2, this fork uses the plugin ID image-s-three-upload

requires.name: S3 access key ID and secret access key

summary: Uploads pasted, dragged or note-referenced images to S3-compatible object storage and replaces them with Markdown links.
